logp.method_description: The octanol/water partition coefficient (Log P), is calculated based on the equation (1): Log P = Log(Coctanol / Cwater). The partition coefficient of complexes 1–7 were determined through the shake-flask method. To prepare water-saturated octanol, 4 mL of octanol was mixed with 1 ml of water and left for 24 h. Similarly, octanol-saturated water was prepared using the same procedure. The complex (50 μM) was then solubilized in 2 mL of saturated water by adding a minimal volume of DMSO, and this solution was added to 2 mL of saturated octanol. The resulting mixture underwent 24 h of shaking using a mechanical shaker, followed by settling and separation. The concentration of the complex was subsequently assessed through UV-vis absorption spectroscopy.
